column1: # Reference engines for rating.sh -- S087, DEC-068.
# The binaries are NOT in this repository and never will be. This file is the
# record of which build each result was played against; an opponent binary is a
# measurement instrument and an unidentifiable one contaminates the result.
# uci_name must be exactly what the binary answers to `uci` with `id name`.
# rating.sh asks every engine before it plays a game and refuses the run on a
# mismatch. That check exists because the first install put the Rustic
# workspace development build (`engine 3.99.36`) at /usr/games/rustic instead of
# the alpha-3.0.6 tag build, which is a different file with a different name.
# ccrl_name must be exactly the CCRL Blitz list entry without its " 64-bit"
# suffix. tools/ccrl_rating.py reads the anchor from the list at run time and
# exits non-zero if the name is not there.
# OPEN, S087: the installed binary is Rustic Alpha 3.0.6 and CCRL rates
# Rustic Alpha 3.0.0, six patch releases apart with nothing here measuring the
# difference. Either alpha-3.0.0 gets built so the anchor names the binary that
# earned it, or the low anchor is recorded as approximate. Owner's call. The
# bracketing run needs no anchor and is not blocked by it.
# OPEN, S087: rustic's binary path is the build tree until the tag build is
# installed as /usr/games/rustic-alpha-3.0.6. The md5 is recorded so the
# installed file can be shown to be the same binary the bracketing run used.
# uci_name
Leorik 1.0
Blunder 5.0.0
